title: Irish Sausage Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful stir fry dish made with Irish sausages, inspired by traditional Irish cuisine.

ingredients.name: Irish Sausages
ingredients.notes: Choose sausages with a good balance of flavor and spice

ingredients.name: Zesty Cooking Oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a flavorful oil to add depth to the dish

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of zesty cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Add the Irish sausages to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
